newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end a shade lower, financials weak.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end a shade lower, financials weak.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended a shade lower Friday after indices had wandered within a narrow range throughout the day, weighed down by weakness in the bank and securities sectors, brokers said. They said a wait-and-see mood was strong ahead of the fiscal year-end, muffling activity.
The Nikkei average finished down 20.70 points or 0.11 percent at 18,189.72. Its June futures were up 20 at 18,210.

"Participants, especially dealers, were reluctant to take up fresh positions ahead of the weekend and the new business year, although there was some window-dressing activity," said Seiki Orimi, an analyst at Dai-Ichi Securities.

Volumne was a scant 259 million shares, the first time it has fallen below 300 million since January 7. On Thursday, 493 million shares changed hands. Losers Friday totalled 514 and gainers 494, while 211 issues were steady.
All U.S. exchanges and most European bourses were closed for the Good Friday holiday.
